name: react-devtools-core
description: Use react-devtools outside of the browser

scripts.build: node init && yarn build:backend && yarn build:standalone
scripts.build:backend: node init && cross-env NODE_ENV=production webpack --config webpack.backend.js
scripts.build:backend:fb: node init && cross-env NODE_ENV=production FEATURE_FLAG_TARGET=core/backend-fb webpack --config webpack.backend.js
scripts.build:standalone: node init && cross-env NODE_ENV=production webpack --config webpack.standalone.js
scripts.build:standalone:fb: node init && cross-env NODE_ENV=production FEATURE_FLAG_TARGET=core/standalone-fb webpack --config webpack.standalone.js
scripts.start:backend: node init && cross-env NODE_ENV=development webpack --config webpack.backend.js --watch
scripts.start:standalone: node init && cross-env NODE_ENV=development webpack --config webpack.standalone.js --watch
